maria (partnerships): Quick sync — SI co-sell coverage gaps. I mapped current partner territories and found ~12 accounts with overlapping claims. Can we agree on rules of engagement + handoff flow?

maria (partnerships): Here's a tiny example CSV of overlaps: 
```csv
acct_id,acct_name,claimed_by,region
AC-1023,GloboCorp,SI:Orion,NA
AC-2045,AtlasHealth,SI:Orion + Sales,EMEA
AC-3098,CloudStor,Sales,NA
```

james (sales): Oof. We should avoid ping-ponging ownership. My high level proposal: sales retains ownership for inbound demos unless SI brings clearly net-new pipeline + a signed MOU before first demo. Also require partner registration in portal. @kevin thoughts?

kevin (si-pm): +1 on MOU. For clarity: SI-claimed opps need (a) partner registration, (b) documented lead source, (c) MOU or channel-reseller agreement. Suggest threshold: >= $150k TCV to be eligible for SI-claim. Also tag opps with `partner_claim=true` in SFDC.

anya (solutions): Also add a technical-fit gate — SI can't claim if customer is in active POC or scoping with our Solutions team. Minimal checklist (for claims): 1) no active POC, 2) signed NDA if required, 3) solution scoping doc + acceptance by Solutions. I'll draft a simple checklist template.

sara (revops): From ops side, we need deterministic account mapping. I'll run a sweep pairing account domains and current owners, then populate a `primary_owner` field in SFDC. Proposal: partner claims expire after 21 days if no opportunity created, auto-release back to AM. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

deploy-bot: Partner registration form v2 deployed to staging: https://internal.redwood/partners/reg-v2 

maria (partnerships): Nice. Action items: James — draft the sales clause, Kevin — share MOU template, Anya — checklist template, Sara — run SFDC sweep + automation. Can we get a consolidated doc by EOD Tue?

james (sales): yep — I'll drop a short clause + examples by Tue noon.

kevin (si-pm): MOU template exists, will publish to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/si-mou and link in this thread by Tue.

anya (solutions): Checklist + scoping template ready — uploading to #partnerships-docs now.

sara (revops): Starting the sweep now. Will post mapping CSV + automation rule snippets when done.

maria (partnerships): One more ask — escalation matrix: if automation finds conflicting claims after expiry, escalate to @maria, @james, @kevin for adjudication. Everyone ok with that? :thumbsup:

james (sales): :thumbsup:

kevin (si-pm): Good plan. I'll also add a small SLA: adjudicate within 48 hours of escalation.

anya (solutions): fine with me.

sara (revops): noted — will include escalation step in the automation.

maria (partnerships): Thanks all — will compile final rules + playbook after your artifacts land and share a one-pager for leadership review.
